nom: Elizabeth Arden Eight Hour HydraPlay Skin Perfecting Daily Moisturizer

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin on hands, elbows, feet, and cuticles report the balm heals cracking and softens rough patches, sometimes overnight.
segments.sensitive: A few reviewers describe sensitive or reactive skin and report the product did not worsen redness, though one was cautious about the menthol scent and one pregnant reviewer suspected heightened sensitivity to the smell.
segments.mature: One reviewer notes using it for years on herself, her daughters, and now her grandchildren, implying long-term use across mature skin without complaint.
segments.normal: Reviewers without stated skin issues describe it mainly as an effective multi-purpose balm for lips, cuticles, and dry patches rather than a daily face product.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers use it for severe dryness on hands, elbows, feet, and lips, reporting fast, sometimes overnight relief and softened, cracked skin; a few note it feels greasy or doesn't fully absorb.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive skin expected the menthol-like scent to cause redness but found it slightly soothing instead; another reviewer's boyfriend used it after shaving for shaving-related redness and cuts with soothing effect.
concerns.barrier: Several describe it forming a protective, occlusive layer that locks in moisture for hours, useful for windburn, sunburn, and healing after treatments or minor cuts.
concerns.spots: One reviewer mentions salicylic acid content helping keep pores clear and prevent acne; no other reviewer discusses breakouts directly.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer states it does not cause breakouts when used on the face or body; no dissenting reports of blemishes appear in the reviews.
concerns.aging: No reviewer directly addresses wrinkles or aging skin outcomes.

aspects.libelle: Thick, balm-like texture slow to absorb
Greasy residue on larger skin areas
Small amount lasts a long time, good value
Scent fades after a few minutes

extraits.texte: This is way overpriced Vaseline, like literally, the only active ingredient is petroleum! Except for I prefer Vaseline because it doesn't smell like diesel. The smell doesn't dissipate it hangs around for-ev-ver. I used it one time as a night time face moisturizer NO WAY NEVER again. You can't use it under makeup because it's petroleum jelly. IT IS PETROLEUM JELLY! Save your money and buy regular Vaseline that the smell is tolerable. My honey asked me if I missed the gas tank. Do not get on any material bc it doesn't wipe off. Definitely would not recommend! IT IS LITERALLY PETROLEUM JELLY!!!!

I received the skin protectant from Elizabeth Arden in exchange for a review. I use this on my hands as my eczema can sometimes cause excess dryness and cracking. This cream is a little greasy and has a strong smell. That said, it is very good at its job. One overnight use of this cream left my hands feeling healed and smooth the next morning. I recommend this if you are prone to dryness and cracking.

The Elizabeth Arden Eight Hour Cream is actually a petrolatum-rich skin protectant. It looks like an orange gelee and it smells medicinal. I have very sensitive skin that reacts to most things, so I thought with the menthol smell it would definitely cause my skin to redden, but it seemed to slightly soothe it and reviewers with average skin types say it is very soothing and healing. It can also be used to shape brows and moisturize cuticles.

I enjoyed using this cream on the sides of my nose where I get dry spots as well as under my eyes for a nice refresh and give some more life. I will say this cream is very thick and does not soak into skin that easily so I liked to use while being out and about rather than before bed. My boyfriend even enjoyed this cream and would use on him face and neck after shaving since he is very prone is redness, dryness and cuts after shaving and he said this helped soothe those areas.

extraits.titre: Excellent Skin Protection and Multi Purpose Cream
extraits.texte: This cream has an unusual odor, however it fades fairly quick. I love this because not only does it have a creamy base but it also contains SA which gently exfoliates and keeps pores clear so you do not have to worry about acne. This is an excellent skin protectant and truly stood the test of time. The texture is more like an ointment for reference.
I love this multi purpose cream. It is more of a gel which is interesting, but it works like a charm. It works on your face or body and does not cause any breakouts. There is no scent which I love.
Ive been using this product for years on myself and 2 girls. Now on my grandchildren. Its remarkable.
